comment: Compute Crafter's Process page config, and its maps file too (docs.maps names it): Git Crafter templates/process/config.json at v7.1.0, with every library map: delivery, deploy, triage, contribute, board, adopt, measure, code, secure, document, release, score and discuss. The Spend map, maps/spend.json, keeps all 6 steps. The five Claudius pack maps (guard, decide, equip, publish, visibility) are named by use, from the pack pinned in quality/config.json (quality_config). Steps dropped before (Board, Triage and Discuss cards, and Contribute deploy) are back with their tabs, Projects and Pages. A step whose metric needs a Projects-read token or local files shows not measured in CI. tests/pack.test.mjs checks the Spend map agrees with maps/spend.json. Keys: Git Crafter actions/pages/action.yml; maps: pages/maps/README.md. The Equip map's Keep step points at Claude Code's plugin loading page, not at the pack's own README: the privacy gate refuses the pack repo's owner name on this page (tests/privacy.mjs, PRIVATE_TERMS).

maps.name: Spend
maps.why: Compute Crafter's compute and credits, from free allowances first to idle capacity dropped
maps.ideal: Use free and included allowances before anything that bills, read their use the same day, and never idle free capacity in a lane over budget.

sources.title: REST API endpoints for billing usage

steps.name: Re-read
steps.rule: Re-read each free-tier figure on its provider's own page, and record the date.

steps.name: Free first
steps.rule: Claim every free allowance before anything that bills.

steps.name: Read
steps.rule: Each allowance's use is read the same day.

steps.name: Stay under
steps.rule: CI stays under the included minutes; no overage, no larger runners.
gates: Spend past the included amount waits for the owner's yes (Git Crafter rules/compute.md)

steps.name: Paid in use
steps.rule: Keep a paid plan only while work runs on it; pause or drop an idle one.
gates: A new paid plan waits for the owner's yes (Git Crafter rules/compute.md)

steps.name: Drop idle
steps.rule: Free capacity in a lane over budget never sits idle; swap in a cheaper lane.
